monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The first-purchase planner strengthens a high-intent path with seller verification, compatible comparisons, total-cost arithmetic, and a ten-gate checkout, but adds no merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, review, or commercial image.

image_qa.note: The two expanded articles and trust update use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. No unsupported query cluster was promoted into a Data-led page: the only meaningful position-4-to-20 opportunity, Stem Cell CBG at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0, was already materially reinforced on October 15 and again with a distinct documented CBG variety on October 24. Today's work therefore protects breadth with evergreen first-purchase, source-routing, and freshness-integrity improvements. Navigational About and Contact impressions, Montana at two impressions, one-impression legal queries, and Blue Dream terms around position 48–70 were ignored as too weak, navigational, or outside the supported range.

authority.action: Expanded the official-source directory into a citation-ready routing and handoff asset with owner, jurisdiction, source type, exact-object, status/date, current-source, limits, and next-route checks. Direct current FDA, CPSC, CDC, OCM, Poison Control, SAMHSA, FTC, DOT, NHTSA, TSA, and USDA routes are separated by job. Reciprocal links strengthen the source, claims, complaint, legal, checkout, and label clusters. No outreach was sent and no speculative outreach target was logged.
